key_insight: SwarmLink adds peer-to-peer coordination to a UAV fleet so photovoltaic inspections can keep working despite lost links, platform failures, or low-quality captures.
engineering_relevance: It enables resilient multi-UAV remote sensing without changing the host autonomy stack, making it practical for large-scale solar plant inspection missions.
method: Extends Aerostack2 with non-invasive inter-agent communication
Uses a distributed auction to assign sensing targets at runtime
Re-auctions remaining targets when failures or data-quality issues occur
evidence_signal: The abstract presents a photovoltaic plant inspection case study showing one unified mechanism can handle initial allocation, failure recovery, and degraded-data reassignment.
watch_item: Performance depends on reliable peer communication and auction timing; large fleets may face latency or coordination overhead in the field.
paper_title: Distributed Coordination for Resilient Multi-UAV Remote Sensing: A Photovoltaic Inspection Case Study
